checks.title: Confirm recovery goal and owner
checks.instructions: Name the merchant outcome, contact approval owner, provider owner, reporting owner, and whether read-only review is the requested result.

checks.title: Bind exact checkout scope
checks.instructions: Record store, market, checkout, campaign, channel, time window, and stable case key. Never use email or cart amount as the checkout/order join.

checks.title: Verify merchant contact policy
checks.instructions: Record channel-specific consent rule, opt-out handling, exclusions, frequency cap, current policy version, and existing Shopify/provider automations for the market.

checks.title: Bind two ready Crews
checks.instructions: Record existing or reviewed new Shopify Growth Analyst and Checkout Recovery Coordinator IDs, skills, setup status, and customer-data access scope.

checks.title: Probe real source access
checks.instructions: Read one authorized checkout including completion state, current linked-order check, consent/opt-out state, and prior Shopify/provider send history. Record exact IDs, permissions, freshness and gaps.

checks.title: Validate checkout handoff
checks.instructions: Run the bundled validator. Reject mismatched checkout, draft without current eligibility, duplicate scheduled send, unapproved send, and order claim without trusted link.

checks.title: Review proposed route
checks.instructions: Show Crew IDs, minimal signal fields, contact-policy gate, validator step, data retention, manual test, cost, approval owner, and any separate send action before Builder applies it.

checks.title: Run one case manually
checks.instructions: Use one real authorized checkout and one suppressed or unknown control. Preserve run IDs, validator result, source evidence and owner decision. Fictional fixtures do not complete setup.

checks.title: Verify contact and outcome ledger
checks.instructions: Keep stable case/action key, prior automation and send check, owner approval, provider receipt if sent, linked-order ID and trusted link if observed. Never call an email click recovered revenue.

checks.title: Choose recurrence and send route
checks.instructions: Record manual-only or an authenticated, deduplicated, cost-bounded review trigger. Test before activation. Contact remains a separately approved route; setup does not enable a message.
